title: HITL Request v1
description: Shared contract between plan_runner (Python) and the Node platform (TypeScript). Both sides write and read this shape when a run pauses for human approval.

run_id.description: plan_runner run id (e.g. 'run_5386e192fa'). Null for requests created directly via the Node API.

step_id.description: Step id where the run paused (e.g. 'hitl').

agent_id.description: Agent or client id (e.g. 'viannalegal'). Used for filtering.

category.description: Category of the decision. Optional; null if unknown.

priority.description: Priority. plan_runner defaults to 'medium' when not specified.

status.description: Current status. plan_runner uses 'pending' when paused; on resume it becomes 'approved' or 'rejected'. 'edit' is a decision (see 'response'), not a status.

title.description: Short human-readable title (e.g. 'Approve spend on paid-pack').

description.description: Longer explanation for the human reviewer.

proposed_action.description: What the run wants to do next (e.g. 'publish', 'spend', 'merge').

allow.description: Which decisions the reviewer is allowed to give. plan_runner-specific; Node API defaults to ['approve', 'reject'].

alternatives.description: Alternative actions considered. Optional; Node platform uses this, plan_runner usually leaves empty.

requested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the request was created.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Null means no expiry. plan_runner currently never sets this.

responded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the decision was made. Null while pending.

response.description: The decision. 'edit' is only valid when 'allow' includes it.

response_comment.description: Optional free-text comment from the reviewer.

metadata.description: Source-specific extras. Not interpreted by the other side.
